{
  "clearExpectedBehavior": true,
  "rationale": "The report explicitly requires one hit per enemy per travel leg, independent of step size. Original Cast creates an actual orb with 100 + 0.5*AP damage; AP is zero. Combat.Damage reduces the outward hit to 50 at 100 MR, while StepShots applies 100 directly on return. These are existing per-hit balances, not new tuning. Speed 11 and range 8 support the selected outbound and completion checkpoints. All state setup precedes casting. The trace reproduces excess damage at both step sizes. The witness checks exact per-leg damage and total damage, so equal but incorrect damage or a missing return hit cannot pass. Passing these checks establishes only this scenario's behavior.",
